name: Claude Accounts
description: Spreads Pi threads across several Claude subscriptions, picking the account with the most headroom and switching between turns when one runs low.

name: Thread Resolved
description: Puts a checkmark on threads whose work is resolved or picked up by another thread, judged by a free OpenCode model.

name: Usage Pace
description: Shows whether the current burn rate lasts until each quota window resets, across multiple accounts, with Codex and Claude reset details.

name: OpenCode Go
description: Writes thread titles and commit messages with an OpenCode Go subscription instead of Codex or bb cloud.

name: Todoist
description: Lists today's and overdue Todoist tasks in bb, completes them, and drafts an agent thread from any task.

name: BB Sidebar
description: A thread sidebar with manual and automatic sorting, snooze, and settle. My patches snooze threads waiting on a scheduled wakeup and keep a parent unread while its subagents work.

name: Magic Compose
description: Picks the project, machine, model, and reasoning level for a new thread as you type. My patch lets it run through OpenCode.
